name: Sheet Pan Chicken Kefta
desc: Ground chicken kefta with grated onion, parsley and cumin, roasted as logs on a sheet pan with blistered cherry tomatoes.

source.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Kefta
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 medium yellow onions, grated, liquid squeezed out
1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
1 tbsp Turkish red pepper paste or tomato paste
ingredients.item: Turkish red pepper paste or tomato paste

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and black pepper, for the tomatoes
4 lavash or pita breads, for serving

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Grate the onions over a kitchen towel set in a bowl, then gather the towel and squeeze out all the liquid. Discard the liquid.
In a large bowl, mix the onion with the parsley, garlic, pepper, cumin, salt and pepper paste. Add the chicken and mix a few minutes, until cohesive.
With wet hands, shape into 8 long logs about 1 inch thick and set them on the pan.
Scatter the tomatoes around the kefta, drizzle everything with olive oil, and season the tomatoes with salt and pepper.
Roast 20 minutes, then broil 5 minutes, until the kefta are browned and read 165°F in the center and the tomatoes have blistered.
Spoon the tomatoes and pan juices over the kefta. Serve with lavash or pita.
tips: Squeeze the grated onion well so the kefta hold together.

His written version adds cilantro, dill, smoked paprika, coriander and turmeric, presses the mixture into one scored slab, and serves it with a smoked paprika garlic mayo and a roasted tomato herb salad.
The pepper paste amount is not in the video; 1 tbsp seasons without making the mix wet.
